newsitem.title: UK: BP shrugs off early Nigerian offshore drill result.
newsitem.headline: BP shrugs off early Nigerian offshore drill result.

text.p: British Petroleum (BP) said on Tuesday it would press ahead with a drilling programme off the Nigerian coast despite disappointing well test results.
"There is a lot of acreage on the Nigerian continental margin and we have only drilled a few wells, mostly in the shallower water," BP Chief Executive John Browne said.

"Initial results are not an indication of the long-term future of the province," he added, citing as an example the North Sea where 60-70 wells were drilled before commercially viable hydrocarbon deposits were discovered.
Browne spoke at a news conference after BP announced a 30 percent increase in its 1996 net profit.
BP, which is operating in alliance with den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil), has drilled four exploration wells on four Nigerian offshore licences as part of an eight-well programme.
